confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge, not live listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable; accommodation (dorm, hostel private, guesthouse, 3-star) is less certain because Siem Reap rates vary a lot by season and area. Wine and cocktail are estimated from typical Cambodian bar pricing, not direct checks. The FX observation came from search summaries of the RBA site, and I did not open the RBA table directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other Southeast Asian tourist hubs with USD-friendly pricing and similar visitor mix, such as Luang Prabang, Hoi An and Chiang Mai, adjusted for Siem Reap's high hotel demand and its Pub Street and Angkor-area premium.
